dedupe_keys.name: ida bd pre and post disaster high resolution satellite imagery for building damage assessment from hurricane ida

description: Ida-BD: pre- and post-disaster high-resolution satellite imagery for building damage assessment from Hurricane Ida is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Cheng-Chun Lee, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). Ida-BD is a dataset with 87 pre- and post-disaster satellite imagery pairs with a very high resolution (0.5m/pixel) from Hurricane Ida 2021 in Louisiana, USA. Ida-BD was obtained from the WorldView-2 (WV2) satellite with very high-resolution images taken in Nov. 2020 and Jul. 2021 for pre-disaster and Sep. 2021 for post-disaster. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-pd9h-6k05. Keywords: Building damage, Hurricane, Satellite imagery, Post-disaster assessment. Published 2022-07-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
